name: @alanwalton/atlas-native-shell
description: iOS Capacitor shell (thin WKWebView over the live atlas.alanwalton.com site). Carries a background-location native seam: the @capgo/background-geolocation + @capacitor/preferences plugins, and the atlas-ios-seam shell script (Info.plist location strings + UIBackgroundModes). Built on the macbook via Xcode. Its four Capacitor dependencies are held in the finding a-capacitor-manifest-cannot-name-the-plugins-it-installs until that check admits them.

scripts.ios:add: bash ../../scripts/write-capacitor-config/write-capacitor-config.shell-script.shell.sh atlas.ios-app.capacitor-config.json && cap add ios && bash scripts/ios-seam/atlas-ios-seam.shell-script.shell.sh
scripts.ios:sync: bash ../../scripts/write-capacitor-config/write-capacitor-config.shell-script.shell.sh atlas.ios-app.capacitor-config.json && cap sync ios && bash scripts/ios-seam/atlas-ios-seam.shell-script.shell.sh
